title: Demonic Hearted Beast
description: A large anthropomorphic demonic creature with curved horns, glowing orange cracks across its head, and large feathered wings stands in a vast hilly landscape. It holds a large glowing purple heart with dripping liquid and a small golden heart at its center, set against a dramatic twilight sky.
